MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Samsung microSD card fits my repeated purchases of removable storage, and its full-size adapter could help me use it across compatible devices.",
    "The HDMI cable fits my habit of buying practical connection accessories and could serve my TV setup if the ports and length are right."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks and Fire TV Ethernet adapter assume I want a streaming setup, but my TV and DVD player purchases do not establish that need.",
    "The Echo speakers and smart plug introduce voice-controlled functions I have not been seeking; my power-strip purchases were about ordinary electrical connections.",
    "The WiFi extender addresses a coverage problem I have not identified, so being another electronics accessory does not make it useful to me now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in other Amazon devices, although those devices serve different purposes.",
    "My TV-related purchases seem to have been interpreted as interest in streaming upgrades rather than maintaining and connecting equipment I already use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, adapters, a card reader, and storage cases show an ongoing need for compatible storage accessories.",
    "My latest lens-cap purchase and earlier tripod purchases point toward continued camera-accessory needs.",
    "My cable and mount purchases depend on specific connectors, dimensions, and equipment compatibility; a broadly related device is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my storage and connection needs but leaned too heavily toward streaming and Alexa devices without a clear reason for me to need them."
}
